name: Hotai Leasing Co., Ltd.
summary: Hotai Leasing Co., Ltd. engages in the passenger car and light truck rental services business. The company leases sedans, SUVs, vans, scooters, and trucks. It offers its products and services through stores and online. The company is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan. Hotai Leasing Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Hotai Motor Co.,Ltd.
